description:
Buildings on a city vacant-building register at or around an address. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "Are there vacant buildings on this block of Lake Street?"
- "Is 2100 Penn Ave N on the vacant building list?"

address.description: A street address in the seven-county Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, city after a comma. Omit for the market-wide count.

cut.description: all: every registered building; commercial: on a commercial parcel; run: on a named run. Default all.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: vacant_buildings_nearby
title: Vacant Buildings Nearby
